selection.auto: hardware Vulkan first, existing C++ CPU fallback
selection.cpu-slang: explicit experimental Slang LLVM AOT convert/candidates plus existing C++ CC/reduce/morphology

native_identity.abi: x86_64 Globals136 Parameters48 Grid24 groups1 whole-frame loops
native_identity.cpu_target: explicit generic; slangc -help states generic CPU baseline

capability.unsupported: Reachable ByteAddressBuffer atomics and group barriers rejected; no fake atomics or erased barriers
capability.new_cpu_wrappers: CPU-specific bounded frame loops, direct preallocated Slot arrays, native precise division; original GPU shader sources unchanged

method.native: Three rotated orders, 80 frames plus 10 warmup per run, fixed last-allowed CPU affinity. Summary is median of three per-run medians/p95 values, not a pooled percentile. All Slang variants compare every output field before timing.
method.lavapipe_one_cpu: One worker (LP_NUM_THREADS=1), same CPU affinity as native, 30 frames plus 5 warmup; separate full-output comparison.
method.lavapipe_default: LP_NUM_THREADS unset, inherited all-CPU affinity, 20 frames plus 3 warmup; separate full-output comparison.
method.time_scope: Submit through finish; excludes compilation, construction, fixture memcpy and numerical comparison. Vulkan CPU timings include upload/readback within submit/finish. Process CPU includes all process threads.
method.power_and_load: No clock or governor locking; paired native order rotates; no station/control workload qualification.
method.causal_limit: Hybrid CPU and software-Vulkan use different CC/morphology algorithms/scheduling. Ratios compare equivalent outputs, not the Slang compiler alone.
